entries.name: Ana
entries.look: One of the WarioWare ninja twins. Ana followed the rescue party with Kat, helped confirm Luigi was alive, and supplied the detail Waluigi needed most before he admitted needing it: Luigi's face had not been burned. Ana's witness statement is short and therefore useful. She saw Luigi moving, saw burns on his arms and legs, and noticed that his face was clear. Waluigi objects to children, teenagers, ninjas, or any combination thereof following him into lava territory. Waluigi also concedes that without Ana's answer, the search would have lost minutes to panic it did not have.

entries.name: Ashley
entries.look: The crew's witch. Said almost nothing at the compound and meant all of it — her two words to the exposed impostor were 'We trusted you,' delivered cold. Worked him over with an enchanted broom, mounted it when he still would not name himself, and took him for the ride that ended with him unconscious, tied up, and out of jokes. The Garden Above the Fire extends Ashley's role from punishment to rescue: she searched from above, found sightlines the ground team lacked, scouted the tunnel exits, and reached the clinic by window because doors remain optional to her. entries.name: Jimmy T
entries.look: One of Wario's crew. Rode in on the Guild job, got out of the car for the reckoning, and did the quiet work of it: crossed arms, cracked knuckles, and the impostor's second arm yanked the other way while Mona held the first. Asked the only question that mattered at the end of the night — 'And step three?' — and got a plan worth grinning at. The Garden Above the Fire gives Jimmy T the practical question after the rescue: once Luigi was found alive, he was the one who asked about a hospital, turning shock into the next step. entries.name: Jory Dobbs
entries.look: Jory Dobbs answered an advertisement for skilled labour, sat through a briefing at which a chair fell over and a vase was destroyed, was offered no share of the treasure whatsoever, pocketed a forged passport in lieu of wages, and found himself in a taped-together charter flying into a storm with a man in a produce sack. He took a bracket to the head in the crash, bled down one side of his face for the rest of the day, tied every knot in the rope chain correctly, and was the first person to say out loud that they had climbed the wrong mountain. entries.name: Kat
entries.look: One of the WarioWare ninja twins. Kat was not part of the compound mission and followed anyway, which Wario called idiotic right up until she reported seeing Luigi alive, burned, limping, and repeating 'find them.' Kat enters the compound-night file from above the lava, which is exactly how Waluigi expects ninjas to enter files he did not ask them to join. She and Ana followed because their friends ran into danger; Wario yelled because that is his love language when someone makes the correct stupid decision before he approves it. entries.name: Mona
entries.look: One of Wario's crew. Rode with the kidnapping party that lifted a smiling Luigi out of the Mages' Guild on forged passes, then spent the drive to Bowser's compound going quietly cold about him — she told Waluigi by phone that their Luigi had given up Mario's location too easily and was not acting like himself. Held the impostor's arm while the others worked him over, and held it tighter when he refused to talk.
